Localization.Name: 600i 2953 Ship Showdown Poster
Localization.Description: Combining exquisite style and cutting-edge technology, it's easy to understand why Origin's 600i sailed into the final four of 2953's Ship Showdown. This poster celebrates the accomplishment with an image of the multi-role luxury liner soaring through the clouds.
